acceptance: Paired bootstrap computes a deterministic paired mean-difference percentile interval from a caller-supplied seed, replicate count, and CI level and rejects fewer than 1000 replicates
Evidence AUROC gives tied positive/negative scores half credit and reports undefined rather than fabricating a value when either class required by AUROC is absent
Evidence AUPRC enters identical scores as one threshold group, reports undefined without positive labels, and documents the exact step-area convention
Reliability artifacts use versioned equal-width bins, preserve empty bins, and disclose interval edges and final-bin inclusivity
Failure-preserving aggregation records requested, completed, failed, per-status counts, and failed item IDs and withholds an aggregate mean whenever any requested item failed
Derived artifact manifests bind source run IDs, evidence packet IDs, source-file SHA-256 hashes, output SHA-256, generator revision, and a canonical manifest digest
Primary-comparison registry and result-set contracts require deterministic ordering, exact comparison coverage, matching experiment revisions, and explicit blocked or undefined reasons
Primary comparison reports bind a 40-character repository revision and serialize deterministically with a canonical report digest
P08 CLI exposes bootstrap, evidence-ranking, reliability, and comparison-report operations using strict JSON inputs and deterministic JSON outputs
Tests cover deterministic bootstrap behavior, score ties, undefined ranking cases, empty reliability bins, failure denominators, manifest binding, report coverage, and blocked comparisons
Final-test access remains sealed and this grain introduces no final-test labels, real clinical benchmark result, model superiority claim, safety claim, or SOTA claim
Exact-head GitHub CI runs Ruff, mypy strict, pytest, and compileall on Python 3.11/3.12 across Linux and Windows
SG-000012 is not marked PROVEN until exact-head CI, exact-head merge, post-main CI, and a separate canonical closeout are complete

minimality.rationale: SG-000011 proved the final-test freeze mechanism, but paper evaluation still lacks frozen statistical uncertainty, ranking, reliability, denominator, and derived-artifact semantics. This grain implements only that missing pre-test infrastructure before any real final-test opening.

requirements: Keep final-test access sealed throughout SG-000012.
Do not ingest or expose final-test labels or results.
Do not turn synthetic/statistical mechanics evidence into clinical or superiority claims.
Never silently remove failed, blocked, timeout, OOM, parse-failure, or evaluation-failure outcomes from denominators.

unresolved_decisions: Real benchmark/data freeze remains for a later P08 grain.
Real GAX checkpoint and baseline qualification state remains for a later P08 grain.
Multiplicity families and exact primary comparisons are frozen only when the real P08 evaluation inventory is populated.
No final-test authorization is permitted by SG-000012.

outcome: Freeze deterministic statistical uncertainty, evidence-ranking, reliability, failure-preserving aggregation, derived-artifact provenance, and primary-comparison report mechanics before real P08 final-test authorization.
rationale: Opening final-test access before fixing confidence-interval, AUROC/AUPRC, reliability, failure-denominator, and table/figure provenance semantics would allow post-test analytical flexibility. SG-000012 removes that flexibility by implementing and qualifying the paper statistics/evidence layer while the final test remains sealed.
